# data analysis


## for virtue ethics


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
# library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)

# Clean input
tokens <- tolower(whoResponsible_clean) %>%
  gsub("[[:punct:]]", " ", .) %>%
  gsub("\\s+", " ", .) %>%
  strsplit(" ")

words <- unlist(tokens)
words <- words[!words %in% c("the", "and", "in", "of", "to", "a", "for", "with", "on", "that")]

text_df <- tibble(word = words)

# Approximate match substitution using base R (adist)
threshold <- 0.2  # normalized edit distance (0 = exact match)
unique_words <- unique(text_df$word)

for (i in seq_along(unique_words)) {
  current <- unique_words[i]
  others <- unique_words[-i]
  dists <- adist(current, others) / pmax(nchar(current), nchar(others))
  
  match_words <- others[dists < threshold]
  if (length(match_words) > 0) {
    cat(match_words, "\n")
    cat("replaced by: ", current, "round:", i, "\n\n")
    
    whoResponsible_clean <- str_replace_all(
      whoResponsible_clean,
      pattern = paste0("\\b(", paste0(match_words, collapse = "|"), ")\\b"),
      replacement = current
    )
    
    unique_words <- unique(whoResponsible_clean %>%
                             tolower() %>%
                             gsub("[[:punct:]]", " ", .) %>%
                             gsub("\\s+", " ", .) %>%
                             strsplit(" ") %>%
                             unlist())
  }
}

# Tokenize and count
text_df <- tibble(person = seq_along(whoResponsible_clean), text = whoResponsible_clean) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)

# Percent
text_df$perc <- round((text_df$n / length(whoResponsible_clean)) * 100, 2)

backup_df <- text_df

# Plot
text_df %>%
  filter(perc > 2) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder(word, perc)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(perc, word)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(10, 20, 30), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_col() +
  labs(y = NULL)

```

```{r}
# Define stop words (can be expanded or replaced with a better list if needed)
custom_stopwords <- c("the", "and", "or", "in", "of", "to", "a", "for", "with", "on", "that", "this", "as", "is", "was", "are", "I", "i")

# Tokenize and clean
tokenized_df <- tibble(
  person = seq_along(whoResponsible_clean),
  text = whoResponsible_clean
) %>%
  mutate(
    text = tolower(text),
    text = str_replace_all(text, "[[:punct:]]", " "),
    text = str_replace_all(text, "\\s+", " ")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(word = list(unlist(str_split(text, " ")))) %>%
  unnest(word) %>%
  filter(!(word %in% custom_stopwords), word != "") %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)

print(tokenized_df)

```



```{r}
nchar(whoResponsible_clean) == nchar(whoResponsible)
t <- 5
whoResponsible_clean[t]
whoResponsible[t]


text_df <- tokenized_df


threshold <- .8
# i <- 2
for(i in 1:length(text_df$word)){
 tmp <- stringdist::stringsim(a = text_df$word[i], text_df$word[-i])
 if(any(tmp > threshold)){
   tmp_match <- text_df$word[-i][tmp > threshold]
   cat(tmp_match, "\n")
   cat("replaced by: ", text_df$word[i], "round:", i, "\n\n")

   whoResponsible_clean <- str_replace_all(string = whoResponsible_clean,
                                           pattern = paste0(tmp_match, collapse = "|"),
                                           replacement = text_df$word[i])

   # paste0("^", tmp_match, "$", collapse = "|")
 }
}

text_df <- tibble(person = 1:length(whoResponsible_clean), text = whoResponsible_clean)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)



text_df$perc <- round(x = text_df$n / length(whoResponsible_clean), digits = 2)*100
text_df

backup_df <- text_df

text_df %>%
  filter(perc > 2) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder(word, perc)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(perc, word)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype="dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, linetype="dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 30, linetype="dotted") +
  geom_col() +
  labs(y = NULL)

```

## for utilitarian ethics

```{r}
unique(dat$questionComprehension[str_detect(string = dat$item, pattern = "utilitarian")])

whichUtilities <- dat$comp_probe[str_detect(string = dat$item, pattern = "utilitarian")]

whichUtilities_clean <- cleanUp(charvec = whichUtilities)
whichUtilities_clean

nchar(whichUtilities_clean) == nchar(whichUtilities)
t <- 1
whichUtilities_clean[t]
whichUtilities[t]



text_df <- tibble(person = 1:length(whichUtilities_clean), text = whichUtilities_clean)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)


threshold <- .8
# i <- 2
for(i in 1:length(text_df$word)){
  tmp <- stringdist::stringsim(a = text_df$word[i], text_df$word[-i])
  if(any(tmp > threshold)){
    tmp_match <- text_df$word[-i][tmp > threshold]
    cat(tmp_match, "\n")
    cat("replaced by: ", text_df$word[i], "round:", i, "\n\n")

    whichUtilities_clean <- str_replace_all(string = whichUtilities_clean,
                                            pattern = paste0(tmp_match, collapse = "|"),
                                            replacement = text_df$word[i])

    # paste0("^", tmp_match, "$", collapse = "|")
  }
}

text_df <- tibble(person = 1:length(whichUtilities_clean), text = whichUtilities_clean)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

text_df <- text_df %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)



text_df$perc <- round(x = text_df$n / length(whoResponsible_clean), digits = 2)*100
text_df



text_df %>%
```
